note_en: The particle 得 after a verb introduces an evaluation of how the action went or what it led to: 那句话说得太重了 "that remark was put too harshly"; 会开得很不愉快 "the meeting went very badly"; 写得清清楚楚 "written out perfectly clearly." First the verb, then 得, then the description; if there's an object, the verb is often repeated or the object is moved forward with 把.
